Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Motion now delegates scaled solving to Gale Cholesky and RSA residualisation uses Gale pivoted QR, superseding the private solve6/solveLinearSystem inventory. HRF Mat/Vec remains on main. work/numerical-ownership-20261003 8f5ac7c2 requires an unpublished Gale override; S0 evidence is not S4/S5 admission. Eidolon adoption remains explicitly deferred by the owner.

Fresh context: Yes: retained migration / upstream prerequisite.

Next action: Resume the exact retained ownership contract, publish/admit required upstream capability through its own authorized route, qualify the current pin without override, then S4/S5/PLS Neuro migration and performance. Retain HRF data ownership/import transition; do not redo already-repaired motion/RSA solvers.

Evidence: modules/motion/.../MotionEstimator.scala; modules/mvpa/.../Rsa.scala; owner D5 notes; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Current inventory / sequential assessment 2026-09-12:
Retain P2; the audit is valid but several historical targets have changed.
- No production scalafim.image.DMat definition was found in the current module scan. Do not plan a second image-matrix migration merely from the old body.
- design/linalg/Qr.scala is a Gale QR adapter: it constructs QROptions, calls .qr and delegates applyQ/applyQT. Its rank/projection/scientific policy and array adaptation are not a private QR factorization family. Likewise MVPA FeatureModel.solve uses Gale Cholesky. Assess adapter allocation/contract defects on evidence, not namespace or method-name matches.
- hrf/linalg/Mat.scala and Vec.scala still implement a public local primitive-array representation; Mat exposes .data and copy/row/column operations. Include consumer ownership, mutation/aliasing, equality, serialization and wildcard exports in its migration contract. The separate re-export mote bd-01KYX0F70J38699FPVBYKCGZDP was consolidated here and closed as duplicate, not repaired.
- MotionEstimator.solve6 remains a private pivoted elimination implementation with an absolute 1e-12 pivot cutoff, used for the Hessian/gradient step. Its fixed six-parameter domain is a possible specialization rationale, not proof of numerical stability or a performance advantage.
- MVPA Rsa.solveLinearSystem remains a private general pivoted elimination implementation with absolute 1e-12 tolerance for partial-Pearson control-RDM residualization. RSA now lives in modules/mvpa, not a standalone rsa module. This is a concrete generic-solver target.

Refined execution/acceptance:
First inventory actual implementations and callers, then replace unjustified generic solvers through Gale. Preserve the estimand and explicit rank/failure semantics; use independent residual/projection oracles, rank-deficient and badly scaled controls/systems, and JVM/JS behavior tests. Measure allocation and numerical conditioning before claiming an improvement; a file deletion, adapter rename or backend call alone is not scientific qualification. Any retained solve6 specialization needs documented domain invariants plus measured reason to retain it. Keep the explicitly deferred wholesale motion/reframe4s migration separate from bounded repair of current numerical code.

For the HRF representation migration, define the public data ownership and import transition before changing Mat/Vec; preserve or deliberately migrate relevant behavior with fixtures and both-platform tests. Retain Complex/FFT pending a justified upstream capability decision. Do not reintroduce the removed scalafim.linalg module.

No implementation, scale-defect reproduction, performance measurement or whole-repository duplicate-free claim is completed by this source assessment.

Original historical scope:

Epic: bd-01KXYJK0XSA3RNH9ANMVC96EPE

Audit and migrate generic numerical duplicates outside scalafim.linalg.

Scope includes scalafim.image.DMat and its Gauss-Jordan inverse, HRF-local Mat and Vec, motion solve6, RSA linear-system helpers, and other private inverse, QR, SVD, or eigen families. Replace image matrices with typed affine or transform wrappers over Gale where appropriate. Move ordinary HRF matrix and vector work to Gale but retain domain-specific Complex and FFT support unless Gale adds a suitable cross-platform complex tier. A tiny specialized solver may remain only with a domain justification and benchmark evidence.

Acceptance
Repository scans find no unjustified generic matrix or solver families outside Gale. Image and HRF public semantics, serialization, equality, and JVM and JS tests remain intact. Every retained specialization is documented with its invariant or performance rationale.
